column1: # Chart: Experiment velocity has increased; published 2026-09-06.
# All 32 values transcribed from browser-hover tooltips on 2026-09-07.
# Four-week trailing average of weekly experiments per active experimenter.
# Multiples relative to the 2025 baseline (2025 = 1x); tooltip precision: 0.01x.
# Neptune experiments exclude evals/automated runs; each owner namespace is
# capped at 100 experiments/day. Compute growth and changes in the active
# experimenter population are not controlled for. Dates are source week labels.
